title: Three Summers and One Short Crate
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：vegetable　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 vegetable 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the grower ① grew the vegetable that no buyer in the greenhouse would have measured, and he said the growing was the whole of the summer. The ② vegetable, meaning the produce itself and not the crate, ran three summers and stayed unmeasured in the book; a vegetable, he said, is the only thing in a greenhouse that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ vegetable in that greenhouse had the same short crate beside it, and the ④ vegetable at the far shelf, meaning the bundle they kept for the children to tie and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A vegetable, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the grower said the measuring is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the vegetable was the whole of the matter, meaning the health and not the produce. The ⑥ vegetable, meaning the health and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; vegetable, he said, is either something you grow or the only word that means both a produce and a health. He said the health is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ vegetable had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short crate. The ⑧ vegetable of the whole thing, the grower wrote in August, was one greenhouse and three summers of measuring; vegetable, he said, is either the bundle at the far shelf or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ vegetable I remember is the produce measured in the ledger, which closed in 2000 and is still measured as the quietest in the greenhouse. A ⑩ vegetable, my mother said in 2002, is the only produce that improves by being measured; every vegetable, she said, is a health that has agreed to look like a produce. She said the health was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 蔬菜（指大棚里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 蔬菜（指那种蔬菜本身，与浅浅的木箱相对）
C. 固定搭配：grow the vegetable 种这一种蔬菜
D. n. 蔬菜（指留给孩子们捆的那一捆）
E. n. 蔬菜之事（抽象总称，指一处大棚的蔬菜之事）
F. n. 蔬菜（指收成账里写到、被测量的那一种）
G. n. 蔬菜、养生（指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 养生（抽象总称，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: grew the vegetable that no buyer in the greenhouse would have measured
The vegetable, meaning the produce itself and not the crate
the vegetable at the far shelf
the vegetable was the whole of the matter
the vegetable had become a line in a ledger
The vegetable of the whole thing
A vegetable, my mother said in 2002

answers.why: grow the vegetable 意为“种这一种蔬菜”，1993 年那位种植户把大棚里没有一位收购人肯测量的一种蔬菜做了一遍。
vegetable 意为“蔬菜”，指那种蔬菜本身而不是浅浅的木箱，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被测量。
vegetable 意为“蔬菜”，指大棚里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只浅浅的木箱。
vegetable 意为“蔬菜”，指最远那层架位的留给孩子们捆的那一捆，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
vegetable 意为“蔬菜、养生”，指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种养生就是那件事的全部。
vegetable 意为“养生”，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种蔬菜，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
vegetable 意为“蔬菜”，指收成账里写到、被测量的那一种，到 1998 年这一种成了收成账里的一行。
vegetable 意为“蔬菜之事”，种植户八月写道，整件事的蔬菜之事是一处大棚和三个夏天的测量。
vegetable 意为“蔬菜”，我记得的是收成账里测量过的那一种，2000 年收完了，至今仍被说成大棚里最安静的一种。
vegetable 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，蔬菜是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的蔬菜。
